why.label: To sell secrets to a foreign power

class_rep.name: The Class Representative
class_rep.persona: Top of the cohort, admired, administrator of the cohort group chat. Composed and helpful; says they are devastated for the cohort.
class_rep.cover: Was in their room at the residence all evening, revising. Saw the message at 23:47 and reported it at once, as any representative would.

topic_lines.leak: "It is a disgrace. I reported it within five minutes. Someone has to care about this cohort."

reveals.L1: A pause. "Of course. I went to return a book. I had quite forgotten."
reveals.L2: "I meant to hand it in. It slipped my mind."
reveals.D1: "How awful. Poor thing. Although it was their card, wasn't it?"

ta.name: The Teaching Assistant
ta.persona: Doctoral candidate who proofread the exam, and the other administrator of the group chat. Nervous.
ta.cover: Proofread the exam on screen. Invigilated another exam from 18:00 to 20:00 with 80 students present.

reveals.D2: Gives way. "I sent it to print. When I went to collect it, my card was gone. I last had it at lunch, in the cafeteria. A lost card is a security report and I did not want one on my file." Confirms staff card {ta_card} is theirs.
reveals.D5: "Yes, I am an administrator. So is the Class Representative. I have not touched that link since it was reset."
reveals.D1: Close to tears. "I did not write that. Who writes to an AI in white ink?"

exchange.name: The Exchange Student
exchange.persona: Second in the cohort; sells private tutoring. Cool and commercial.
exchange.cover: Tutoring six clients at a beach café from 18:00 to 20:30. The 'something special' promised to clients was a mock exam of their own.

topic_lines.leak: "If I had the paper I would have sold it. Giving it to everyone makes it worthless. Ask who is better off when an exam is worth nothing."

reveals.D4: "Then I was going to win on Friday. Ask who stops me."

professor.name: The Professor
professor.persona: Wrote the exam; valuation adviser on the sale of Meridian Silicon. Irritable, evasive about the evening, and far more upset about Question 5 than about the leak itself.
professor.cover: Was at a faculty dinner in Lisbon. Rewrote Question 5 at 16:10; only he has that version, on a laptop that was with him all evening. Sent v3 to the Teaching Assistant at 11:00. Printed nothing.

topic_lines.exam: "Whoever leaked this leaked yesterday's draft. Question 5 used illustrative figures. Entirely made up. Who told you they were real?"

reveals.L4: "A woman? I have no idea who that could be."
reveals.D8: Mortified. Admits there was no faculty dinner, and that Question 5 of v3 used the real Project Lantern figures. "She asked about my laptop all evening. I thought she was interested in discounted cash flows." Her first message on Thursday came at 20:06: "Running late, darling." His bag never left his chair.

companion.name: The Companion
companion.persona: Introduces herself as a semiconductor consultant; the Professor's mistress. Charming, vague, answers questions with questions, mostly about the Professor's consulting work. A sharp professional who never admits to being a spy. No accent or nationality jokes.
companion.cover: Came to see the Professor, who forgot their appointment; waited in the faculty lobby; took the train to Lisbon; dinner with him in Chiado from 21:00. "His bag never left his chair. He is very attached to it."

topic_lines.leak: "If I wanted your exam, darling, you would never know it was gone. Putting it in a group chat? That is amateur work."

reveals.L4: "I was lost. Your corridors all look the same."
reveals.D5: "A woman likes her privacy. Mine was the five past eight."
reveals.D1: She reads Question 5 slowly and smiles for the first time. "How generous of your students."

D1.title: The leaked PDF
D1.text:
SV_Final_v3.pdf. Six pages headed "Semiconductor Valuation, Final, v3". Question 5: "Value Meridian Silicon using the figures below." The figures carry a footer: "Strictly confidential. Project Lantern."

File properties: created Thursday 19:20 by a phone scanning app; text layer added 19:25. The pages sit slightly crooked, as if photographed. A faint band at the foot of each page reads "Secure Print, job 88213, LIB-1".

D2.text: Secure printing: jobs wait 12 hours in the queue and are released at any station by a swipe of the owner's card. An administrator release is possible but is always logged as admin=true.

D3.title: The sealed exam
D3.text: The paper locked in the Dean's safe is headed v4, finalised Thursday 16:10. Question 5: "Value {pastry}." No Meridian, no Project Lantern. The leaked paper is not the exam.

D4.title: Rules and standings
D4.text:
Article 14: an assessment found to be compromised is annulled. Until a resit is held, grades are computed from the remaining components.

Fellowship rules: awarded to the student ranked first at 18:00 on Friday, with 20,000 euros and an analyst offer. No resit can be held before January.

Standings after the midterm: Class Representative 18.4, Exchange Student 18.3.
Mock finals: Exchange Student 19, 18, 19. Class Representative 15, 14, 15.

D5.title: The anonymous number
D5.text:
The anonymous number is a prepaid SIM, activated Thursday 20:21 on the Carcavelos cell tower. It joined the group at 23:46 through the invite link. The link was reset on Wednesday and is visible only to the group's two administrators: the Class Representative and the Teaching Assistant.

The Kiosk Owner at the station sold two prepaid SIMs for cash that evening: "At five past eight, an elegant lady. She buys one most weeks. At twenty past, someone young, hood up, paid in coins."

D8.text: "Meridian Silicon CEO resigns over relationship with alleged Chinese intelligence officer." The photo shows the Companion. A second article: "Meridian sale, code-named Project Lantern, advised by" the Professor.

L4.text: The Cleaner's log: the Professor's office locked at 16:30, no sign of entry, printer unused. At 19:40 the Cleaner saw a well-dressed woman, not a student, trying the handle. She smiled, said she was lost and walked away.

L5.text: The bartender confirms a table of seven from 18:00 to 20:30, with six payments made to the Exchange Student's phone.
